<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
function mixedReviewBadRight(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get($incoming): mixed { global $sample; echo "G;"; return $sample; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
};
$selector = "value";
$sample = 0;
echo empty($reader->$selector) ? "EMPTY_INT;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
$answer = $reader->$selector ?? mixedReviewBadRight();
echo $answer === 0 ? "INT;" : "BAD_INT;";
$sample = true;
echo empty($reader->$selector) ? "BAD_BOOL_EMPTY;" : "NONEMPTY_BOOL;";
$answer = $reader->$selector ?? mixedReviewBadRight();
echo $answer === true ? "TRUE;" : "BAD_TRUE;";
$piece = "a";
$sample = $piece . "b";
$answer = $reader->$selector ?? mixedReviewBadRight();
$sample = "changed";
echo $answer === "ab" ? "COPY;" : "BAD_COPY;";
$reader = null;
echo $selector === "value" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "ISSET;"; return true; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming): mixed {
        global $reader;
        echo "GET;";
        $reader = null;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; throw new Exception("receiver-mixed-none"); }
};
$selector = "gone";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $reader->$selector ?? 9; }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getLine(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getPrevious() === null ? "ROOT;" : "BAD_ROOT;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo $selector === "gone" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
